findings.finding: The current nonzero S2 epsilon axis is degenerate on the sealed unit-code capture: epsilon 0.01 already maps to threshold floor(0.01*16*127)=20, while every nonzero contributor has magnitude one and a 16-wide group is bounded by 16. Every active FC1 block is therefore dropped at every nonzero epsilon point.
findings.impact: The apparent 100% block/product/weight reduction is an all-drop diagnostic endpoint, not a usable accuracy/performance Pareto point. Paired AEE, per-sequence delta AEE, and same-resource cycle speedup are absent, so S2 cannot be admitted or described as a paper result.
findings.remediation: Do not build S2 RTL from M1763. If S2 is revisited, parameterize the sweep by integer absolute-code thresholds such as 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 15 (equivalently epsilon below 0.01), then require the already specified paired 40-sample AEE and same-resource gates before any admission.

findings.finding: The transferred M1763 result does not contain the M1707 fc_frames.bin payload. M1775 independently reconstructed and matched the epsilon-zero decision hash and rehashed the complete producer hash map and all epsilon result rows, but it cannot independently replay the four nonzero-epsilon active-group bit payload hashes from aggregate CSV/JSON alone.
findings.impact: The four producer hashes remain sealed provenance, not a different-author payload replay. This does not weaken the diagnostic all-drop proof or change paper_admission=false, but those hashes must not be represented as independently reproduced.
findings.remediation: Only if the hashes are needed beyond diagnostic provenance, provide the sealed M1707 reduced binary capture read-only to a successor hammer or add a separately sealed per-pair decision-digest receipt. Do not edit M1763.

findings.finding: The consumed M1763 attempt namespace is an empty directory.
findings.impact: This is not P0: M1765 promised one fresh attempt namespace and no automatic retry, not a sealed attempt receipt; M1763 creates the directory with atomic mkdir only after authority/freshness checks and never removes it. The empty directory is a valid one-shot semaphore, but it is not self-describing. RUN_COMPLETE also retains the inherited M1721 diagnostic label, so result identity should be taken from the sealed M1763 decision.json rather than the marker text.
findings.remediation: Create, without modifying the empty directory or M1763 result, a small additive double-sealed receipt binding the attempt path, atomic-mkdir semantics, M1765 release SHA, M1763 result triple, analysis_runs=1, result_publications=1, and automatic_retry=false. It may also explain the inherited RUN_COMPLETE label.

scope: Different-author read-only result hammer over the locally transferred sealed M1763 diagnostic tree. No M1763 analysis, capture replay, GPU, EDA, network, result modification, or docs/359 modification was performed.
single_next_action: Keep M1763 as diagnostic screening only. If TSBG remains active, next price context tags, broadcast control, full area/energy, and a same-resource implementation; do not use the 2.90x/5.12x screening roofline ratios as admitted speedup. S2 remains NO-ADMIT until a nondegenerate integer-threshold sweep has paired AEE and same-resource cycles.
